purpose: Batch-controlled comparison: linear probe on LLM latents vs the frozen BulkFormer-93M encoder, computed INSIDE each holdout series.
why_this_metric: Zero non-holdout series contains both classes, so pooled AUC can reward batch/series signature. All 92 holdout series are mixed by construction, so comparing samples inside one series holds batch, platform, lab and largely tissue fixed. Only per-sample biology can order them.
method: out-of-fold predictions from the same grouped 5-fold linear probe (StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed 20260707) by series_id, StandardScaler + balanced LogisticRegression) used by run_regen_eval.py; no sample is scored by a model that saw it
verdict: On the batch-controlled metric the LLM's advantage largely disappears. Weighted mean favours the LLM (+0.0150); unweighted mean (-0.0303), median (-0.0348) and the count of series above chance (65 vs 68) favour the ENCODER. Read as a wash, not a win.

IMPORTANT_CAVEAT.issue: The discrim row comes from a RECONSTRUCTED checkpoint, not the one that produced the reported 0.7034.
IMPORTANT_CAVEAT.detail: Only the LoRA adapter, connector and configs were downloaded before the training pod was deleted; the frozen base language_model and vision_tower were rebuilt from source. Training ran --bf16, so the trainer saved bf16-rounded base weights and the adapters were fitted against those; the rebuild writes higher-precision weights from HuggingFace. Same architecture, genuinely different weights.
IMPORTANT_CAVEAT.evidence: The rebuild scores mean-of-folds 0.6617 +/- 0.0836 where the original scored 0.7034 +/- 0.0563, with fold 0 at 0.501 vs 0.768. It is a different model and is labelled as such.
IMPORTANT_CAVEAT.status: The discrim within-series figures are INDICATIVE, not the measured value for the reported model. A faithful number requires a retrain with full checkpoint retention.

note_on_metric_choice: pooled-OOF and mean-of-folds disagree materially on this population (encoder 0.6429 pooled-OOF vs 0.6680 mean-of-folds; data-fix LLM 0.6829 vs 0.6664). Quote which one is meant.
